mapper.sql: SELECT eval_id, supplier_id, supplier_name, eval_period, eval_type, incoming_total, incoming_pass, ppm, pass_rate, quality_score, delivery_score, service_score, total_score, grade, eval_status, del_flag, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM qms_supplier_eval
mapper.delete: UPDATE qms_supplier_eval SET del_flag = '2' WHERE eval_id IN #{evalId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS incomingTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN inspect_result = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomingPass FROM qms_insp_task WHERE del_flag = '0' AND task_type = 'IQC' AND task_status = '2' AND supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{period}
